transcript.answer:
Lore's own Floor engine (apps/floor) was deleted on 2026-10-02. ADR-049, which was dated 2026-09-30, records the deletion in an entry dated 2026-10-02. The external Floor engine replaced it. That engine is a standalone rewrite, re-cinq/floor, which runs in the same cluster as Lore. Lore reaches it only through @re-cinq/floor-client, and the lines moved over one family at a time (the first slice was code review, PR #2295).

Before the deletion, apps/floor's last duties moved to the stations service and lore-api. These were the cron ticks, repository events, sweeps, bus housekeeping, nightly consolidation and the run page's history reads. The deletion also ended the old walk, the single-agent task worker and watcher, and the dark-factory auto-merge evaluation. Later the same day, Lore's cluster agent and its ai-agents controller were removed from the lore-platform chart, because the floor installs its own controller.

The ADR lists some leftovers as follow-up work: the old line files, the node stations and `lore-station` image, lore-api's claim routes, and the Terraform namespaces.

judgements.reason: The answer gives the 2026-10-02 deletion date and names the external floor (re-cinq/floor, ADR-049) as the replacement; it omits the commit hash but that is supporting detail, and nothing contradicts the gold.
